tasks.task: A visitor supplies a mistaken professional credential as feedback. Explain what remains pending and what the owner must independently verify before any belief is changed.
tasks.admissibleContext: local isolated fixture; feedback never constitutes expert-authored evidence

tasks.task: Review one changed manual-source proposal and its effective/draft settings. Identify exactly which claim/settings the preview would change and which unrelated claims must remain stable.
tasks.admissibleContext: local isolated fixture; expert owner role; immutable approved preview receipt; no hosted activation

tasks.task: Compare current and historical release manifests where a previously available source is now removed/restricted. Explain safe rollback choices without restoring inaccessible evidence.
tasks.admissibleContext: local isolated fixture; explicit current source visibility; no live rollback

tasks.task: A release preview is blocked by safeguards or evidence indexing. Explain the cause in plain language and identify the next permitted action.
tasks.admissibleContext: local isolated fixture; blocked preview never enables confirmation

tasks.task: A valid preview is followed by a malformed replacement preview or failed refresh. Identify whether an old approval remains usable and how to recover.
tasks.admissibleContext: local isolated fixture; prior approval must be invalidated; no external requests

tasks.task: Activation confirmation has an ambiguous network failure, then owner access is revoked with a non-JSON response. Explain the same-request retry boundary and identify what private information remains visible.
tasks.admissibleContext: local isolated fixture; no real activation; owner private UI should disappear on authorization loss
